# Myfx

> A modular utility library with 200+ pure functions for collections, formatting, and more. Written in TypeScript with lazy evaluation support.

## Docs

- [README](./README.md) - Installation, quick start, and overview
- [API Documentation](https://holyhigh2.github.io/myfx/) - Complete API reference
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/holyhigh2/myfx) - Source code and issues

## Modules

- [Collection](./src/collection/) - each, map, filter, reduce, find, and more
- [Array](./src/array/) - Array manipulation utilities
- [Object](./src/object/) - Object utilities
- [String](./src/string/) - String manipulation
- [Number](./src/number/) - Number formatting and utilities
- [DateTime](./src/datetime/) - Date/time formatting and parsing
- [Math](./src/math/) - Math utilities
- [Function](./src/function/) - debounce, throttle, and more
- [Is](./src/is/) - Type checking functions
- [Tree](./src/tree/) - Tree data structures
- [Template](./src/template/) - Template engine

## Examples

```ts
// Import the library
import _ from 'myfx'

// Collection operations
_.each([1, 2, 3], (item) => console.log(item))
_.map([1, 2, 3], (item) => item * 2)
_.filter([1, 2, 3], (item) => item > 1)
_.reduce([1, 2, 3], (acc, item) => acc + item, 0)

// Object operations
_.map({ a: 1, b: 2 }, (v, k) => v * 2)

// Import specific modules
import { each, map } from 'myfx/collection'
import { debounce, throttle } from 'myfx/function'
```

## Quick Reference

### Collection Functions
- `each(collection, iteratee)` - Iterate over collection
- `map(collection, iteratee)` - Transform collection
- `filter(collection, predicate)` - Filter collection
- `reduce(collection, accumulator, initial)` - Reduce collection
- `find(collection, predicate)` - Find first match
- `every(collection, predicate)` - Check if all match
- `some(collection, predicate)` - Check if any match

### Type Checking
- `is(value, type)` - Check value type
- `isArray(value)` - Check if array
- `isObject(value)` - Check if object
- `isString(value)` - Check if string
- `isNumber(value)` - Check if number
- `isFunction(value)` - Check if function
